authorization: rotation-driven axillary fold-volume helper bones only (user authorisation for r101); no corrective shape keys, pose-space morphs, broad re-rig, bind-pose change or global weight solve

mechanism.structure: axvol_<fold>_<s> is a child of glenohumeral_half_<s> with a rest frame identical to it, so with zero offset it reproduces the half helper exactly; vertices transfer a fraction of their glenohumeral_half weight to it, so base motion is unchanged and each vertex receives exactly (transferred weight) x (helper offset)
mechanism.drive: helper local location = a_max * smoothstep(d0, d1, d) * n_local, where n is the fold band's outward surface normal (rest, expressed in the half helper's frame, so it rotates with the band) and d is the distance between two probe points 0.2 m along the humerus axis: probe child of upperarm_<s>, probe_ref child of glenohumeral_ref_<s>. Hence d = 0.4 sin(theta_gh/2), a function of glenohumeral swing only (axial twist does not move an on-axis point); monotonic in swing, exactly 0 at rest; d0 > 0 makes the response exactly zero at low elevation
mechanism.driver_type: Blender simple scripted expression (clamp/smoothstep from min/max), LOC_DIFF variable; no Python drivers; no dependency cycle (probes depend on upperarm/ref, helper depends on probes and the half helper, nothing depends on the helper)
mechanism.axial_rotation: not used in the first screen; added only if measured anatomy requires it, with an amendment

scope.weights: for small local bands on the anterior and posterior folds only: a fraction (<= band_max 0.8) of each vertex's glenohumeral_half weight moves to the fold helper; all other weights unchanged exactly; mirror-exact; <= 4 influences (the helper replaces part of an existing influence; if a vertex has no half weight it is not in the band)

measurements: driver response d and offset vs abduction/flexion 0-170 x internal/neutral/external
fold displacement vs r98 for band vertices
rejection: hides the membrane from one camera only
regresses r98 press/squat/pull-up collisions or stretch/compression
